room_rent.display: Shared room (15% copay) or Single room (30% copay)
room_rent.note: No explicit room rent cap in ₹ or % of SI; instead, accommodation type drives mandatory co-payment: 15% for shared/lower, 30% for single/higher. Emergency cardiac/accident in single room attracts only 15%.

icu.note: ICU charges are covered under in-patient treatment; no separate cap or co-payment mentioned for ICU beyond the accommodation co-payment structure.

copayment.display: 15% (shared room) or 30% (single room); 30% for listed surgeries
copayment.note: 15% copay for shared/lower accommodation and all day-care procedures; 30% for single/higher accommodation; 30% for 14 listed illnesses/surgeries (cataract, hysterectomy, CABG, joint replacement, etc.). Copays do not stack for listed-illness claims.

sub_limits.display: 30% copay on cataract, joint replacement, CABG, angioplasty & 10 others
sub_limits.note: 14 procedures/illnesses attract a 30% co-payment (not a fixed ₹ sub-limit): cataract, hysterectomy, cholecystectomy, TURP, hernia, angiography, arthroscopy, discectomy, mastectomy, joint replacement, PTCA, hydrocele, major organ transplant, CABG.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period applies; an endorsement option exists to delete it entirely.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 24 or 12 mo via endorsement)
ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting is 36 months. Endorsements available to reduce to 24 months or 12 months (paid options).

specific_disease_waiting.note: Standard 24-month wait for listed conditions (ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, urogenital, eye, others). Endorsement options to reduce to 12 months or delete entirely.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: 5% non-cumulative discount on renewal premium (claim-free year)
cumulative_bonus.note: This is a renewal premium discount, not a sum-insured bonus. No cumulative SI increase mentioned.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

day_care.note: Day-care procedures under GA or LA in hospital/day-care centre covered; 15% co-payment applies.

domiciliary.note: Covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available; treatment must exceed 3 days.

ayush.note: Only in-patient AYUSH treatment in a recognised AYUSH Hospital is covered. OPD AYUSH not covered.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses of organ donor covered; donor's pre/post-hospitalisation excluded.

ambulance.note: Emergency ambulance only; non-emergency and non-registered providers excluded.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a covered or excluded benefit.

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, etc.) are listed as non-medical expenses and explicitly excluded.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only; all payments in INR within India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), claims cannot be contested except for fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium payment mode; 30 days for all other payment modes.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; must apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, treatment outside India, OPD, congenital external anomalies, stem cell harvesting, sleep apnoea investigation, hearing aids/spectacles, non-medical expenses

optional_riders.display: Waiting period reduction endorsements (30-day waiver, 24→12mo specific disease, 36→24 or 12mo PED)
